status_definitions.completed: All assigned modules, tasks, checklists, and assessments completed with passing scores.
status_definitions.assessment_required: A required practical task assessment or quiz is pending evaluation.
status_definitions.behind_schedule: Assigned stage activities have passed target completion timelines.
status_definitions.requires_attention: Performance scores or completion percentage is below configured thresholds.
status_definitions.on_track: Onboarding progress is proceeding within expected schedule and quality standards.
